headline: Crypto Market Structure Brief - 12 October 2026
summary: Ethereum leads chains by TVL at 51.87 billion USD, followed by Solana and Base. Uniswap V4 recorded the highest 24-hour DEX volume at 844 million USD while Tether generated the most fees. USDT remains the largest stablecoin at 184 billion USD circulating, with multiple peg deviations noted. Base holds the highest L2 TVS at 16.0 billion USD amid several recent DeFi incidents.
